title: BigP3BCI Study I — 9x8 checkerboard/performance-based (13 healthy subjects)
description: This dataset is a BIDS-formatted derivative of Study I of the bigP3BCI collection, which contains EEG recordings from 13 healthy participants using a P300-based speller with a 9x8 checkerboard character grid and a performance-based paradigm. EEG was recorded from 16 channels at 256 Hz, with target and non-target stimulus events annotated using HED. The data support machine-learning benchmarking of P300 brain-computer interface classification with calibration-then-test evaluation.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) from 16 channels in a standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz, with a 60 Hz line frequency. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task in a laboratory setting with online feedback. Events were labeled Target or NonTarget, with a trial interval of 0-1.0 s.
